core_memory.user_sailing: I've been sailing since I was younger, and it's one of my favorite hobbies. There's something about the rush of wind against the sails and the sense of freedom on the water that I love. It's a great way to clear my mind and challenge myself with problem-solving.
core_memory.user_gym: I started going to the gym regularly in college to balance out my sedentary coding lifestyle. It's helped me physically and mentally, giving me more energy, improving my mood, and enhancing my productivity. It's a great stress-reliever after long coding sessions and helps me sleep better at night.
core_memory.research_experience_short: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year. It's been an eye-opening experience. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor suggested I join a lab focused on data visualization for big scientific datasets. It turned out to be a great decision.
